$description: GENERATED by extraction/build_leakage_patterns.py from the real source project. Used by the GENERATION_MODE_* rules in schema/semantic_validate.py (mode = generation only; clone mode may reuse source content). Copy is hashed (5-word shingles), URLs/hosts are fingerprinted; no source copy or source URL is stored as text. Detection is string-based: paraphrase is not caught. No human has reviewed these patterns.
normalisation: semantic_validate.normalize_match: NFKC, zero-width + soft hyphen removed, curly quotes straightened, unicode dashes -> '-', whitespace collapsed, lower-case; tokens [a-z0-9]+('[a-z0-9]+)*

BRAND.match: word boundary, case-insensitive, on normalised text; also any brand.* asset role and the brand's asset files

CUSTOMER.match: single names: case-sensitive word on normalised text (they are also common words); entities: case-insensitive phrase; any case inside a partner.logo slot

PERSON.match: asset basenames of real people's photos (and their derived renders) + the person roles; the source names no individual

SCREENSHOT.match: asset basenames of the source app's real UI screens / share image

ASSET.match: basename of any other source asset file (case-insensitive)

COPY.match: any 5-token window of a PageSpec string whose sha256 is listed, or a whole 3-4 token string

CLAIM.match: as COPY, for source strings carrying a number, time, fee or speed claim

URL.match: full-URL or host fingerprint of a source URL; and in generation mode every absolute URL must be on a reserved .example or .invalid host

notApplicable.EMBED: The source has no iframe/video/third-party embed (grep of src/ and index.html); any embed URL in a generation PageSpec is still rejected by GENERATION_MODE_URL.
notApplicable.STORE: The source has no App Store / TestFlight / Play link or badge; a store URL in a generation PageSpec is rejected by GENERATION_MODE_URL (non-placeholder host).
notApplicable.RATING: The source shows no reviews or ratings.
